## TMDb Data Acquisition

This document uses the TMDb API to collect movie financial and descriptive data for the ISA 401 theatrical movie analysis.

The input is the 20-movie pilot dataset created in `00_movie_selection.Rmd`.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)

# Run chunks from the project root
knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = normalizePath("..")
)

# Never store or display the API token
stopifnot(nzchar(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")))
```

## Load the Shared Movie Master

```{r load_master}
movie_master <- read.csv(
  "data/processed/movie_master.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Validate the input before making API requests
stopifnot(
  nrow(movie_master) == 20,
  !anyDuplicated(movie_master$movie_id),
  !anyDuplicated(movie_master$tmdb_id),
  !anyNA(movie_master$tmdb_id)
)

# Display the first five records
head(movie_master, 5)
```

```{r}

# Retrieve movie details using a confirmed TMDb ID

get_tmdb_details <- function(tmdb_id) {

  response <- request(
    paste0(
      "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/movie/",
      tmdb_id
    )
  ) |>
    req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  movie <- resp_body_json(
    response,
    simplifyVector = TRUE
  )

  tibble(
    tmdb_id = movie$id,
    tmdb_title = movie$title,
    original_title = movie$original_title,
    budget = movie$budget,
    reported_revenue = movie$revenue,
    runtime_minutes = movie$runtime,
    genres = paste(movie$genres$name, collapse = ", "),
    original_language = movie$original_language,
    tmdb_release_date = movie$release_date,
    status = movie$status
  )
}

# Test the function on Barbie before processing all 20
barbie_details <- get_tmdb_details(346698)

print(barbie_details, width = Inf)

```

```{r}

# Collect financial and descriptive data for all 20 movies
# Use the confirmed TMDb IDs from the shared movie master

tmdb_details <- purrr::map_dfr(
  movie_master$tmdb_id,
  get_tmdb_details
)

# Merge results with permanent project movie IDs
movie_tmdb_raw <- movie_master |>
  left_join(
    tmdb_details,
    by = "tmdb_id"
  )

# Validate the collection
stopifnot(
  nrow(movie_tmdb_raw) == 20,
  !anyDuplicated(movie_tmdb_raw$movie_id),
  !anyDuplicated(movie_tmdb_raw$tmdb_id)
)

# Check data completeness
movie_tmdb_raw |>
  summarise(
    total_movies = n(),
    missing_budget = sum(is.na(budget) | budget == 0),
    missing_revenue = sum(
      is.na(reported_revenue) | reported_revenue == 0
    ),
    missing_runtime = sum(
      is.na(runtime_minutes) | runtime_minutes == 0
    )
  )


# Display all 20 movie financial records
movie_tmdb_raw |>
  select(
    movie_id,
    title,
    release_year,
    budget,
    reported_revenue,
    runtime_minutes
  ) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  print(n = 20)

```

```{r}

# Identify movies with usable financial information

movie_financial_check <- movie_tmdb_raw |>
  mutate(
    budget_available = !is.na(budget) & budget > 0,
    revenue_available = !is.na(reported_revenue) &
      reported_revenue > 0,
    financials_complete = budget_available &
      revenue_available
  )

# Show each movie's financial-data status
movie_financial_check |>
  select(
    movie_id,
    title,
    release_year,
    budget_available,
    revenue_available,
    financials_complete
  ) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  print(n = 20)

# Summarize financial coverage
movie_financial_check |>
  summarise(
    total_movies = n(),
    complete_financials = sum(financials_complete),
    incomplete_financials = sum(!financials_complete)
  )

```

```{r}

# Clean financial data and preserve all 20 movies

movie_tmdb <- movie_financial_check |>
  mutate(
    # TMDb uses zero for some unavailable financial figures
    budget = if_else(budget > 0, as.numeric(budget), NA_real_),
    reported_revenue = if_else(
      reported_revenue > 0,
      as.numeric(reported_revenue),
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Only calculate the ratio when both values are usable
    box_office_to_budget_ratio = if_else(
      financials_complete,
      reported_revenue / budget,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Document the source of the financial information
    financial_source = "TMDb API"
  )

# Validate the cleaned data
stopifnot(
  nrow(movie_tmdb) == 20,
  !anyDuplicated(movie_tmdb$movie_id),
  sum(movie_tmdb$financials_complete) == 15,
  sum(!is.na(movie_tmdb$box_office_to_budget_ratio)) == 15
)

# Save the cleaned dataset
dir.create(
  "data/processed",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  movie_tmdb,
  "data/processed/movie_tmdb.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Confirm the output
file.exists("data/processed/movie_tmdb.csv")

```

```{r}

# Retrieve the earliest U.S. theatrical release date
# Type 2 = limited theatrical
# Type 3 = theatrical

get_us_release_date <- function(tmdb_id) {

  response <- request(
    paste0(
      "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/movie/",
      tmdb_id,
      "/release_dates"
    )
  ) |>
    req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  release_data <- resp_body_json(
    response,
    simplifyVector = FALSE
  )

  us_records <- purrr::keep(
    release_data$results,
    function(x) identical(x$iso_3166_1, "US")
  )

  if (length(us_records) == 0) {
    return(as.Date(NA))
  }

  theatrical <- purrr::keep(
    us_records[[1]]$release_dates,
    function(x) x$type %in% c(2, 3)
  )

  if (length(theatrical) == 0) {
    return(as.Date(NA))
  }

  dates <- purrr::map_chr(
    theatrical,
    function(x) substr(x$release_date, 1, 10)
  )

  min(as.Date(dates), na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Retrieve the date for all 20 movies
us_release_dates <- purrr::map(
  movie_tmdb$tmdb_id,
  get_us_release_date
) |>
  unlist() |>
  as.Date(origin = "1970-01-01")

# Display results without changing the saved dataset yet
release_check <- data.frame(
  movie_id = movie_tmdb$movie_id,
  title = movie_tmdb$title,
  release_year = movie_tmdb$release_year,
  us_theatrical_date = us_release_dates
)

print(release_check, row.names = FALSE)

# Check for missing U.S. theatrical dates
sum(is.na(us_release_dates))

```

```{r}

# Add verified U.S. theatrical dates to the TMDb dataset
movie_tmdb <- movie_tmdb |>
  mutate(
    us_theatrical_date = as.Date(us_release_dates),

    # Verify theatrical release year matches the master list
    theatrical_year_matches = (
      as.integer(format(us_theatrical_date, "%Y")) ==
        release_year
    )
  )

# Validate movie identifiers and release dates
stopifnot(
  nrow(movie_tmdb) == 20,
  !anyDuplicated(movie_tmdb$movie_id),
  !anyDuplicated(movie_tmdb$tmdb_id),
  sum(is.na(movie_tmdb$us_theatrical_date)) == 0,
  all(movie_tmdb$theatrical_year_matches)
)

# Save updated cleaned dataset
write.csv(
  movie_tmdb,
  "data/processed/movie_tmdb.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Verify saved dataset
saved_tmdb <- read.csv(
  "data/processed/movie_tmdb.csv"
)

nrow(saved_tmdb)
table(saved_tmdb$financials_complete)
file.exists("data/processed/movie_tmdb.csv")

```

```{r}

# Compare financial-data coverage by selection method

movie_tmdb |>
  group_by(selection_method) |>
  summarise(
    total_movies = n(),
    complete_financials = sum(financials_complete),
    missing_financials = sum(!financials_complete),
    coverage_pct = round(
      100 * mean(financials_complete), 1
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}

# Save financial coverage by selection method

financial_coverage <- movie_tmdb |>
  group_by(selection_method) |>
  summarise(
    total_movies = n(),
    complete_financials = sum(financials_complete),
    missing_financials = sum(!financials_complete),
    coverage_pct = round(
      100 * mean(financials_complete), 1
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Export the validation summary
write.csv(
  financial_coverage,
  "data/processed/financial_coverage_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Verify export
file.exists(
  "data/processed/financial_coverage_summary.csv"
)

```
